app.name: Tatakai
nav.label: Main navigation
home.empty.title: Nothing to show yet
home.empty.body: Check your connection, or reorder metadata sources in Settings.
search.hint: Press Ctrl+K to search from anywhere
search.empty.title: Search for an anime
search.empty.body: Type at least two letters. Results come from your metadata sources.
search.no_results.title: No results
search.no_results.body: Nothing matched "{query}". Try another spelling or the original title.
search.select_prompt: Select a result to see its details here
details.no_episodes.title: No episode list
details.no_episodes.body: The metadata sources have no episodes for this title yet.
details.no_extension.title: No source installed
details.no_extension.body: Install a .kai extension to resolve streams for this episode.
player.error.title: Playback failed
player.error.trying_next: That source failed. Trying another one.
player.error.no_more: No other source is available for this episode.
player.error.no_player: The video player could not start. Check the log in the logs folder of the app's data directory.
player.shaders_missing: Upscaling shaders are missing. Run packaging\fetch-deps.ps1 and restart.
player.shortcuts: Space: play/pause. Left/Right: 5 s. F: fullscreen. Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+6: upscaling.
preset.title: Upscaling preset
settings.title: Settings
settings.player.preset_hint: Applied when playback starts. Heavier presets need a capable GPU.
settings.metadata.hint: The first source that answers wins. A failing source is skipped for 60 seconds.
settings.link.hint: Pair phones and tablets to use this PC for enhanced playback.
settings.about.body: Tatakai Next is free software under the AGPL-3.0-or-later. Fonts are under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. Video playback uses libmpv and FFmpeg (LGPL).
account.title: Sync your history
account.body: Signing in syncs your watch history with your Tatakai account. Everything else works without it.
account.not_configured: This build has no account service configured. Add the Supabase URL and anon key to config.json in the app's data directory to enable sync.
link.title: Tatakai Link
link.intro: Pair a phone so it can ask this PC to enhance video. Pairing is local to your network.
link.scan_hint: Scan the code with Tatakai on your phone, or type the code below. It works once.
link.allow_private.hint: Adds a Windows Firewall rule for private networks so phones can reach this PC. Windows will ask for administrator permission.
link.status.running: Link server is running on port {port}
ext.title: Extensions
ext.intro: Extensions (.kai) resolve streams for episodes. Only install extensions you trust.
ext.install.invalid: Choose a file with the .kai extension.
ext.empty.title: No extensions installed
ext.empty.body: Install a .kai package to start watching.
ext.remove.title: Remove this extension?
ext.remove.body: {name} will be deleted from this PC.
ext.cannot_enable: This extension needs features that are not available in the native app.
error.rate_limited: A source limited requests. Another source will be used shortly.
error.no_source: No source could provide this video.
error.auth: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.
error.addr_in_use: That port is already in use by another program.
error.not_wired: This is not available in this build yet.
home.row_error: AniList rate-limited the request. This row will reload from Kitsu.
details.provider_hint: Installed extensions that offer this title. Tried in order.
settings.palette_hint: 10 curated palettes. The full scheme is derived from the seed with Material Color Utilities.
settings.reduce_motion_hint: Springs without bounce and no ambient animation.
settings.player.skip_hint: ani.zip and AniSkip markers when available.
settings.data.hint: Everything lives in the app's data directory on this computer. No telemetry.
settings.about.uptodate: You are on the latest version
settings.data.telemetry_hint: This build sends nothing. No switch because there is nothing to turn off.
account.lists: AniList and MAL lists arrive in M1.
link.no_devices_body: Open a pairing window and scan the code from Tatakai on your phone.
link.revoke.title: Revoke this device?
link.revoke.body: {name} loses access immediately and must pair again.
link.status.error: The Link server could not start
link.err.port: Port {port} is already in use by another program.
link.err.port_fix: Close that program or change the port in Settings, then try again.
ext.install.drop: Drop a .kai file here or click to choose one
ext.compat.partial_hint: Search and streams work; the custom catalog is skipped.
lib.title: Library
lib.m1: AniList and MAL lists (Watching, Planned, Completed…) arrive in M1.
src.title: Episode sources
src.mode.hint: Automatic picks the best match for your preferences and moves to the next one if it fails. Manual asks before playing.
src.m2: Torrent arrives in M2 (libtorrent engine on desktop)
src.choose_first: Pick a source for this episode
src.failover: If it fails, the next one in the list is tried
gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.intro: Every Tatami Expressive component with its states. Debug builds only.
lib.empty.title: Nothing here yet
lib.empty.body: Episodes you watch show up here to continue later.
player.error.no_player_at: The video player could not start. Check the log in {dir}.
account.not_configured_at: This build has no account service configured. Add the Supabase URL and anon key to config.json in {dir} to enable sync.
player.external.title: Playing in external mpv
player.external.ended: Finished. Close mpv or go back.
player.external.hint: Use mpv's own controls and shortcuts. Closing mpv brings you back here.
player.external.not_found_cause: Install mpv or set its path in Settings > Player.
player.external.searched: Searched PATH and the usual install locations.
player.embed.own_window: The video can't be shown inside the window here, so mpv plays it in its own window.
player.enhanced.fallback: mpv-anime-build is not available. Playing with the embedded engine.
settings.player.engine_hint: How video plays. A change applies the next time you start an episode.
settings.player.mode.embedded_hint: mpv inside this window with Tatakai's controls. Works on Linux and Windows.
settings.player.mode.embedded_enhanced_h: The same embedded player with the mpv-anime-build profiles, shaders and scripts.
settings.player.mode.external_hint: Your own mpv in its own window, with your config and controls. Tatakai shows what is playing.
settings.player.enhanced_ui.ours_hint: Tatakai's controls and shortcuts; uosc stays off.
settings.player.enhanced_ui.uosc_hint: The build's uosc interface and key bindings; Tatakai's controls hide.
settings.player.anime_hint: Verified and unpacked into the data folder once. Starting an episode also prepares it if needed.
settings.player.anime.missing_hint: This installation does not include mpv-anime-build, so the enhanced mode is unavailable.
settings.player.mpv_path_hint: The mpv that external mode starts, with your own config and controls.
settings.player.mpv_path_auto: Empty = autodetect (PATH and the usual install folders)
settings.player.mpv.no_version: Found, but it did not start
settings.player.mpv.not_found_custom: There is no file at that path. Fix it or clear the field to autodetect.
settings.player.mpv.install.linux: Install mpv with your package manager (for example sudo pacman -S mpv or sudo apt install mpv) or set its path.
settings.player.mpv.install.windows: Install mpv (mpv.io, scoop or winget) or set the path to mpv.exe.
settings.player.mpv.install.mac: Install mpv (for example brew install mpv) or set its path.
settings.player.preset_hint_embedded: Embedded mode only: the enhanced build brings its own shaders and external mpv uses your config. Applied when playback starts; heavier presets need a capable GPU.
link.firewall_other.hint: Tatakai does not change your firewall. If you use one (ufw, firewalld or your desktop's firewall settings), allow incoming TCP port {port} on your private network so phones can reach this computer.
torrent.title: Torrents
torrent.placeholder: This part of the torrent client is being built.
src.filter.title: Filters
src.filter.empty.title: No source matches the filters
src.filter.empty.body: Turn some filters off to see more sources.
player.torrent.no_file_cause: No file in this torrent matches this episode. Pick it in the torrent's Files.
player.torrent.batch_next: Next episode from the same torrent
torrent.shell.intro: Watch while it downloads. Everything stays on this computer.
torrent.shell.empty_body: Play a torrent source from an episode, or check the Library for saved torrents.
torrent.shell.pick_body: Overview, Files, Peers and Trackers show one torrent at a time.
torrent.shell.missing: This torrent is no longer in the session. It may have been removed after watching.
torrent.overview.remove_body: It stops downloading and sharing and leaves the library.
torrent.files.empty_body: The file list appears once peers send the torrent's metadata.
torrent.files.col.name: Name
torrent.peers.empty_body: Looking for peers through DHT, PEX and the trackers.
torrent.trackers.empty_body: This torrent finds peers through DHT and PEX only.
torrent.library.intro: Torrents saved by the app: open one in the client, keep it after watching or delete it.
torrent.library.error: Could not load the torrent library
torrent.library.empty.title: No torrents yet
torrent.library.empty.body: Torrents you play or download from the source picker show up here.
torrent.library.col.name: Series
torrent.library.delete_body: It leaves the library and stops downloading and seeding.
torrent.library.delete_files_hint: Off: the video files stay in the download folder.
torrent.downloads.intro: Torrents that keep downloading while you watch something else or nothing at all.
torrent.downloads.settings_error: Could not load the torrent settings
torrent.downloads.warn.title: Background downloads use your computer
torrent.downloads.warn.body: While the app is open, saved torrents keep downloading and sharing even when nothing plays. This means:
torrent.downloads.warn.cpu: Some CPU use to check and write pieces.
torrent.downloads.warn.disk: Disk space and writes in the download folder.
torrent.downloads.warn.network: Network traffic, which counts against metered or capped connections.
torrent.downloads.warn.upload: Uploading to other peers: your IP address is visible to them.
torrent.downloads.warn.note: You can turn background downloads off at any time in Torrents > Settings.
torrent.downloads.switch_hint: Keep downloading and seeding saved torrents while the app is open, and allow downloads from the source picker.
torrent.downloads.off_banner: Background downloads are off: saved torrents pause when you stop watching.
torrent.downloads.empty.title: Nothing downloading
torrent.downloads.empty.body: Choose Download in the source picker of an episode to fetch it for later.
torrent.downloads.empty.body_off: Turn background downloads on to fetch episodes for later.
torrent.settings.intro: How the torrent engine downloads, connects and stores files.
torrent.settings.error: Could not load the torrent settings
torrent.settings.port_hint: 0 = random port. Other peers connect to you here.
torrent.settings.port_invalid: Use 0 or a port from 1024 to 65535
torrent.settings.upnp_hint: Ask the router to open the listen port (NAT).
torrent.settings.max_peers_hint: Peers connected at the same time per torrent.
torrent.settings.dht_hint: Find peers without trackers (needed for most magnet links).
torrent.settings.pex_hint: Learn about more peers from the connected ones.
torrent.settings.lsd_hint: Find peers on your local network.
torrent.settings.after_watch_hint: Delete frees the space when the player closes; Keep leaves the torrent in the library.
torrent.settings.background_hint: Saved torrents keep downloading and seeding while the app is open.
torrent.settings.background_locked: Accept the warning in Downloads first.
torrent.settings.fix_fields: Fix the highlighted fields to save
torrent.settings.saved: Torrent settings saved. Port and discovery changes apply when no torrent is playing.
torrent.settings.save_failed: Could not save the torrent settings
